title: Win And Teleport
features:
🕹️ What This Script Does
- Lets you teleport to a win!
- You get to pick which win to teleport to.
- (There are 6 kinds of teleports.)

🌍 Where It Works
- Basa Worlds
- Cyber World

🔄 Rebirth Options
- Normal (Once) → Rebirths you just once.
- Loop → Rebirths you over and over.
- Stoop

⚠️ Important Stuff:
- I didn't make this; I'm just sharing it.
- Credit thanks to ArchiveXNova
- 🔑 The key you need is in the script already.
- Just letting you know it uses a key system.
- Check out their Discord for how to use it and get the key.
- For supported games this is a hub and there are many
